title: ר' אושעיא זעירא דמן חברייא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rabbi Oshaya the younger of Chavraya. Rashi: the academy’s youngest. Rashi suggests that he was called Oshaya the younger, and “of Chavraya” means of the academy, chapter Hashochet 31a. Ta'anit, chapter 3, 24a: Rashi says he was called this because another Oshaya was there; all his deeds there were for Heaven’s sake. Tosafot, Chullin, first chapter, 12b: Chavraya is a place name, as in Bereshit Rabbah 13; see above, Avimi. The Arukh explains “younger” because there is Oshaya the great. Rashi and Tosafot say nothing at Niddah 26a about the byname.
